sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Melocactus pachyacanthus is a succulent cactus from eastern Brazil, adapted to seasonally dry tropical habitats. Kew retains it as an accepted species but notes that a 2025 classification treats it as a synonym of M. azureus.

sections.title: Stem, cephalium and flowers
sections.text: The globose, ribbed stem bears strong spines and a reddish apical cephalium. Small flowers and fruits emerge from the cephalium. The plate shows these features; the sources consulted do not provide reliable dimensions.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No solid food use was found for this species.
